intent.text: Recommend that the vsect maturation plan be checked by one independent reviewer from another model family. The review must mark specific defects and unverified claims in place without grading the draft, and remain attached to the artifact. The author must address or decline each finding in writing and cannot self-certify. A council is convened only after review and revision, strictly to resolve an explicit, unresolved estate-level policy or risk decision (not to approve or grade the draft), and any such council must include at least one member from a family distinct from the author's.
